cohort: 101 women with breech presentation and 202 matched controls with cephalic presentation who underwent induction of labor beyond 37 weeks of gestation at Lille University Hospital, France, between January 2014 and December 2020.
finding: Induction of labor beyond 37 weeks of gestation was found to be as effective in breech presentations as in cephalic presentations, with no significant difference in the rates of cesarean section or transition to active labor.
